title: Weak convergence rate for the Cox-Ingersoll-Ross process
summary: We study the weak convergence rate of a drift-implicit discretisation scheme for the Cox-Ingersoll-Ross (CIR) process in the regime where the process remains strictly positive. Specifically, we consider scheme~(4) of Alfonsi~\cite{A}, which arises naturally from applying a drift-implicit Euler step to the SDE satisfied by the square root of the CIR process and admits a unique positive closed-form solution at each time step.
